base_candidate.role: frozen Nautilus execution, costs, account, external pools and current-NAV risk path

prior_failure.diagnosis: V5 used a response-qualified state as broad permission to retrade markets which had already delivered the common move. Causal plan-to-position attribution showed 53 accepted-market trades produced 5 wins and -107001.215528 USDT, while eight sole-excluded-market trades produced three wins and +42826.148130 USDT. The latter is concentrated exposed evidence and motivates only an ownership test.

research_question: When exactly three markets have already converted common flow into price progress, does the sole excluded market become a tradable delayed information receiver only after it forms its own fresh post-activation auction leg?

hypothesis.state_detector: The V5 five-minute response-qualified initiative detector is unchanged: prior completed five-minute ATR, two distinct events, at least three common markets, positive median signed progress, majority advance and majority origin hold.
hypothesis.information_ownership: Markets already present in the current accepted_symbols have supplied the state evidence and are terminal no-trade. They cannot use the same broad move again as independent continuation permission.
hypothesis.residual_receiver: A tradable market exists only when accepted_symbols contains exactly three valid markets. The sole excluded market is the residual receiver; a four-market response has no residual receiver and is no-trade.
hypothesis.entry: The residual market must independently complete the unchanged fresh post-activation five-minute MSS, directional displacement, strict three-candle FVG and passive first consequent-encroachment retracement.
hypothesis.invalidation_and_target: The unchanged stop remains beyond the protected swing or opposing bar and the target remains the next causally live completed-4H or previous-day external liquidity pool. Entry, invalidation and target belong to the residual market's new leg.
hypothesis.family_isolation: V1-V3 SCDAM, SESSION_I7, and V5 accepted-market continuation plans remain terminally rejected. Development measures only residual-laggard delivery.
hypothesis.rejection_semantics: A post-only parent rejection while flat is expected passive non-execution. Any order rejection after fill is an engine error and immediately fail-closes exposure.

router.progress_rule: positive median signed log return and majority advance
router.origin_rule: majority remains beyond the first confirming origins
router.tradable_market_policy: sole market excluded from current accepted_symbols

selection.method: E01-E06 are the same exposed diagnostic weeks used by V4 and V5. Reuse is intentional for controlled market-ownership comparison and cannot support a success claim.

claim_rules: E01-E06 are exposed development periods and can only reject or improve the residual-delivery mechanism.
The V5 residual-market attribution is post-hoc, concentrated in E01, and is not success evidence.
The V5 detector, entry geometry, target, invalidation, costs, risk and global-slot rules remain unchanged so V6 isolates market ownership.
Passing development permits a source freeze and newly predeclared confirmation; it is not success.
Success requires a frozen continuous-account evaluation with realistic costs and no liquidation or unrecoverable account damage.
